function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period, vendor_id, sku, unit_price_orig, contract_unit_price, qty, fx_rate, (unit_price_orig - contract_unit_price) * qty * fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period = '2026-08'
AND unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price","purpose":"Check for excess unit price in August 2026"}
